producer_report.summary: Plan grouping (plan.rs `disjoint`) now ignores the shared append-only files, so items that all touch CHANGELOG.md or docs/decisions.md can share a parallel group. The list is one constant, `SHARED_APPEND_ONLY` (CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md, README.md), with a doc comment citing parallel-jobs.md section 9. The module docs describe the exception. Root cause: the overlap test counted these files as a clash, so every group was a single item. An entry whose only paths are shared files names nothing else and stays ungrouped. Landing-check authority for conflicting shared-file edits is unchanged, and the docs say so. I also edited parallel-jobs.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/decisions.md and drain.rs. I did not re-read those four in this pass.
